items.description: As the world prepares to mark the 40th anniversary of the Chernobyl disaster on April 26, the nuclear power industry finds itself in the midst of a striking resurgence. items.title: IDF removes 40 Israeli settlers who crossed into Syria

featured_image.name: Israeli troops remove Israeli settler group who crossed into ...

items.description:
Around 40 Israeli settler activists from the far-right Pioneers of Bashan organization crossed into Syrian territory on Wednesday, barricading themselves on a rooftop on the outskirts of the Druze village of Hader at the foot of Mount Hermon and demanding the Israeli government approve Jewish settlements in Syria.[1][2][3]

The Israeli military said the group gathered near the northern border before advancing several hundred meters — roughly half a kilometer — into Syria. IDF troops escorted the activists back to Israeli territory and handed them over to police.[2][1]

"The IDF strongly condemns this incident and emphasizes its severity, which constitutes a criminal offense that endangers civilians and IDF troops," the military said.[1][2]

items.title: Israeli airstrike kills journalist in southern Lebanon

featured_image.name: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon kill Lebanese journalist ...

items.description:
Lebanese journalist Amal Khalil was killed on Wednesday in an Israeli airstrike in the southern village of al-Tiri, prompting Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam to accuse Israel of committing war crimes against media workers. Khalil, 43, a reporter for the daily newspaper Al-Akhbar, had been covering renewed hostilities in southern Lebanon when she was struck and buried under rubble for hours before her body could be recovered.[1][2]

Khalil and freelance photographer Zeinab Faraj were reporting near al-Tiri when an Israeli strike hit a vehicle in front of them. The two journalists ran into a nearby house for cover, which was then also hit by an Israeli strike, according to Lebanon's health ministry and military officials. Faraj sustained a head injury and was evacuated to Tibnin Hospital, where she underwent surgery and is in stable condition. Khalil was trapped beneath the rubble for roughly six hours before rescuers retrieved her body.[3][4][5][1]

items.title: Israeli airstrike kills 5 near mosque in northern Gaza

featured_image.name: Israeli airstrike kills 5 Palestinians in Rafah, southern Gaza

items.description:
An Israeli airstrike struck a group of civilians near the Al-Qassam Mosque in Beit Lahia, northern Gaza, on Wednesday night, killing five Palestinians including three children, according to Gaza's civil defense agency.[1][2][3]

"Five Palestinians, including three children, were killed in an Israeli airstrike that targeted a group of civilians near Al-Qassam mosque in Beit Lahia," the agency said in a statement carried by AFP. The bodies were transported to Al-Shifa hospital in Gaza City, which confirmed receiving them. The civil defense did not specify the ages of the children killed. The Israeli military told AFP it was checking the reports.[1]
